name: Innovex Fully Automatic Washing Machine IFA70S (7kg)
description: 7kg Innovex fully automatic top-load washing machine with steel inner tub, wave wash pulsator and rust-free plastic body. Ideal for small to medium families.
details: The Innovex IFA70S is a 7kg fully automatic top-load washing machine designed for everyday family use. It features a steel inner tub, multi-pulsator wave wash, rust-free plastic body, transparent lid and auto power off. Power backup helps protect the wash cycle during short power cuts. Multiple wash programmes make it suitable for different fabric types in Sri Lankan homes.
